caption.text:
Nenek berusia 90 tahun menjadi korban pemerkosaan di Kabupaten Grobogan, Jawa Tengah, Rabu (29/6/2026).

Pelaku, RU (31), masuk ke rumah, lalu mengancam korban. Saat itu, korban berada di rumah sendirian karena keluarganya sedang bertakziah.

Kapolsek Grobogan AKP Sunarto mengatakan, pelaku ditangkap pada Rabu (15/7/2026).

"Kami proses perkara ini secara tuntas sesuai ketentuan hukum yang berlaku," ujar Sunarto, Kamis (16/7/2026).

🎥: polres_grobogan_official

Kreatif: Safira Nurulita

caption.text_translation:
A 90-year-old grandmother became a victim of rape in Grobogan County, Central Java, Wednesday (29/6/2026).

The perpetrator, RU (31) entered the home, then threatened the victim. At that time, the victim was home alone as his family was mourning.

Kapolsek Grobogan AKP Sunarto said, the perpetrator was arrested on Wednesday (15/7/2026).

"We are processing this matter thoroughly in accordance with the legal provisions in place," Sunarto said, Thursday (16/7/2026).

🎥: polres_grobogan_official

Penulis: New Dwi Putranto Nugroho, Vachri Rinaldy Lutfipambudi
